name: squid girl world - visitor
source:
Sepia and Aseroe spend lazy days on a mushroom covered planet communicating with each other poorly. Aseroe disappears in the mornings, and Sepia spends all day bathing in the lake.

But maybe all of that will change when  a stranger visits the two of them...?

[From [url=https://ophanimkei.itch.io/squid-girl-world-1]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
塞皮亚和阿塞罗在一个蘑菇覆盖的星球上度过了慵懒的日子，彼此之间的沟通很差。阿瑟罗 (Aseroe) 早上就会消失，乌贼 (Sepia) 一整天都在湖里沐浴。

但也许当一个陌生人拜访他们两个时，这一切都会改变……？

[来自[url=https://ophanimkei.itch.io/squid-girl-world-1]itch.io[/url]]
